frozen.method: batch-mean t-intervals: 20 batches of 400 consecutive draws, 19 df; point estimates from the full R=8000 matrices, se = sd(batch statistics, ddof=1)/sqrt(20), differences formed within each batch first
frozen.stopping_rule: this single batch (seed 20261020, R=8000); no augmentation

family.budget: 20 intervals for D = B_c - B_UNIF (non-uniform candidates)
family.mE: 20 intervals for m_E^(C) (non-uniform candidates; one per candidate, serving all floors)
family.pairs: 210 intervals for Delta m_D^(C)(i) - Delta m_D^(C)(j), all unordered pairs (contains every comparison vs UNIF and vs the incumbents)
family.rule: each unique interval counted once; t_{19, 1-0.05/(2M)} applied to every interval

classifier.budget: confirmed if upper end <= 0, rejected if lower end > 0, else undecided
classifier.mE: m_E >= lambda0 confirmed if lower end >= lambda0, rejected if upper end < lambda0, else undecided
classifier.UNIF: definitional values: budget confirmed, m_E = 1, Delta m_D = 0
classifier.feasibility: rejected if budget rejected or (lambda0 != none and m_E rejected); confirmed if budget confirmed and (lambda0 = none or m_E confirmed); else undecided
classifier.sets: challengers = confirmed feasible; c excluded if some challenger b has lower end of (dmD(b) - dmD(c)) > delta; candidate near-optimal set = feasibility not rejected and not excluded; groups: confirmed-feasible, feasibility-undecided
